title_sq: SHITET GODINE MULTIFUNKSIONALE 3-KATESHE TEK RRUGA E DIBRES! 1,600,000 €
description_sq:

- Sipërfaqe trualli: 420 m²

- Kati përdhe: 145 m²

Kati 2 eshte i pershtatur ne nje apartament 1+1 per banim dhe ne nje ambient te pershtatur per qender kursesh e ndare ne tre klasa te ndryshme.
Kati 3 eshte i organizuar ne nje apartament 3+1 i mobiluar ne menyre bashkekohore me sistem qendror ngrohje-ftohje.
Tarraca eshte e pershtatur per vendosjen e paneleve diellore.
Karakteristika të Objektit:
Ndërtim cilësor me materiale të standardit të lartë. Planimetri funksionale me ndriçim natyral në çdo kat;
E përshtatshme për banim, zyra, klinika, qendra shendetesore, qendra edukimi, konvikte, hotel apo zhvillim të kombinuar.
Hapësirë parkimi dhe ambient i gjelbëruar përreth; Objektit ka hapsiren e nevojshme per vendosjen e nje ashensori te brendshem .
Dokumentacion i rregullt (certifikatë pronësie, leje ndërtimi, etj.)
Investim ideal për banim afatgjatë ose zhvillim biznesi!
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone ju lutem me kontaktoni!
title_en: 3-STOREY MULTIFUNCTIONAL BUILDING FOR SALE ON DIBRA STREET! €1,600,000
description_en: LEDA (Impact122826) 3-Storey Building for Sale on Rruga e Dibra, Tirana; The property is located in one of the most sought after and rapidly developing areas in Tirana. The property offers excellent access to main roads, public transport and is only minutes from the city centre. Property Details; - Land area: 420 m² - Total built area: 580 m² - Ground floor: 145 m² - First floor: 145 m² + 275 m² veranda - Second floor: 145 m² - Third floor: 145 m² Each floor is organized as follows: Floor 0 functions as a Bar - Billiards and is currently rented out. The 1st floor is a coffee bar in working condition with a high clientele and a consolidated turnover. Also, on the 1st floor, there is also a space for rent for a Photo Studio. The 2nd floor is suitable for a 1+1 apartment for living and an environment suitable for a course center divided into three different classes. The 3rd floor is organized in a 3+1 apartment furnished in a contemporary way with a central heating-cooling system. The terrace is suitable for placing solar panels. Property Features: Quality construction with high standard materials. Functional layout with natural lighting on each floor; Suitable for residential, offices, clinics, health centers, education centers, dormitories, hotels or combined development. Parking space and surrounding green environment; The building has the necessary space for placing an internal elevator. Regular documentation (ownership certificate, building permit, etc.) Ideal investment for long-term residence or business development!
